title: Three-tense verb table
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 4 (Three-tense verb table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 4: My school day in the past, present and future. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: My online school day
points: يَبْدَأُ الدَّرْسُ الأَوَّلُ فِي السَّاعَةِ التَّاسِعَةِ

parts.text: أَمْسِ دَرَسْتُ العُلُومَ وَكَانَ الدَّرْسُ مُمْتِعًا.
اليَوْمَ أَدْرُسُ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَأُحِبُّهَا لِأَنَّهَا لُغَةُ القُرْآنِ.
غَدًا سَأَكْتُبُ اخْتِبَارَ الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Three sentences, three time frames, one opinion with an attached pronoun

questions.q: Make past and future: أُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ فِي المَسْجِدِ.
questions.a: Past: صَلَّيْتُ الظُّهْرَ فِي المَسْجِدِ. Future: سَأُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ فِي المَسْجِدِ.

questions.q: Translate: Yesterday the lesson was long.
Core: Write a paragraph about your school day with two sentences in each time frame (portal response box). Starter: أَمْسِ ...
questions.a: For example: أَمْسِ دَرَسْتُ التَّارِيخَ. كَانَ الدَّرْسُ مُمْتِعًا. اليَوْمَ أَدْرُسُ الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ. أُحِبُّهَا لٰكِنَّهَا صَعْبَةٌ. غَدًا سَأَدْرُسُ العُلُومَ. سَأَكْتُبُ تَقْرِيرًا، إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.

questions.q: Extend: Add one opinion with لِأَنَّهُ or لِأَنَّهَا in each time frame.
Stretch: Translate: Yesterday I studied science, today I am studying Arabic and tomorrow I will write an essay.
questions.a: أَمْسِ دَرَسْتُ العُلُومَ، وَاليَوْمَ أَدْرُسُ العَرَبِيَّةَ، وَغَدًا سَأَكْتُبُ مَقَالًا.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the future?
questions.a: C) سَأَكْتُبُ الوَاجِبَ. سَـ + present = future: I will write the homework.

questions.q: Past 'I' verbs end in: A) ـتُ B) سَـ C) أَـ
Big question: say one sentence about yesterday, today and tomorrow at school.
questions.a: For example: أَمْسِ دَرَسْتُ، اليَوْمَ أَدْرُسُ، غَدًا سَأَدْرُسُ.
